clients.createTable:

  `gstin` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `pan` varchar(20) DEFAULT '',
  `orders` int DEFAULT '0',

  `outstandingBalance` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `creditLimit` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Active',
  `tier` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Gold',

  `milkQuantity` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `fatPercentage` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `snfPercentage` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `chillingCenter` varchar(120) DEFAULT '',
  `routeNumber` varchar(60) DEFAULT '',
  `collectionTiming` varchar(60) DEFAULT '',
  `landAcres` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `cropTypes` varchar(200) DEFAULT '',
  `soilType` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `irrigationSource` varchar(120) DEFAULT '',
  `kisanCreditCard` varchar(60) DEFAULT '',
  `subsidyScheme` varchar(150) DEFAULT '',
  `animalDetails` varchar(255) DEFAULT '',
  `numberOfAnimals` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `shopLicenseNumber` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `distributorName` varchar(120) DEFAULT '',
  `territoryCoverage` varchar(150) DEFAULT '',
  `storageCapacity` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',
  `annualTurnover` varchar(100) DEFAULT '',

  `brands` text DEFAULT NULL,

  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,

inventory.createTable:
CREATE TABLE `inventory` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `productId` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `productName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(120) DEFAULT 'General',
  `unit` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Bags',
  `currentStock` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `minStockAlert` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '10',
  `warehouseLocation` varchar(150) DEFAULT 'Main Warehouse',
  `lastUpdated` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `extraData` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `productId` (`productId`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_product` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `products` (`productId`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

invoices.createTable:
CREATE TABLE `invoices` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `invoiceNumber` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `clientId` varchar(60) DEFAULT '',
  `clientName` varchar(200) DEFAULT '',
  `clientType` varchar(60) DEFAULT 'Farmers',
  `clientGstin` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `clientContact` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `clientAddress` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `date` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `dueDate` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `items` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `subtotal` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `cgstTotal` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `sgstTotal` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `igstTotal` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `discountTotal` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `grandTotal` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `paymentStatus` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Unpaid',
  `paidAmount` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `balanceDue` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
  `paymentMode` varchar(40) DEFAULT 'Cash',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `extraData` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `invoiceDate` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Official transactional invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD)',
  `paidDate` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Date when invoice was settled',
  `totalCost` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Sum of line item cost prices (costPrice * qty) at time of sale',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `invoiceNumber` (`invoiceNumber`),
  KEY `idx_invoices_invoice_date` (`invoiceDate`),
  KEY `idx_invoices_client_id` (`clientId`),
  KEY `idx_invoices_payment_status` (`paymentStatus`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin AUTO_INCREMENT=180001

payments.createTable:
CREATE TABLE `payments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `paymentNumber` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `invoiceId` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Reference to Invoice.invoiceNumber',
  `clientId` varchar(60) DEFAULT '',
  `amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `paymentDate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `paymentMode` varchar(40) DEFAULT 'UPI Commercial / NEFT',
  `status` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Completed' COMMENT 'Completed, Pending, Failed, Refunded',
  `reference` varchar(100) DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Bank UTR, Transaction Ref, Cheque No',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `paymentNumber` (`paymentNumber`),
  KEY `idx_payments_invoice_id` (`invoiceId`),
  KEY `idx_payments_client_id` (`clientId`),
  KEY `idx_payments_date` (`paymentDate`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin AUTO_INCREMENT=30001

products.createTable:

stock_movements.createTable:
CREATE TABLE `stock_movements` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `productId` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Reference to Product.productId',
  `quantityChange` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '+ for inward/purchase, - for outward/sale/adjustment',
  `type` varchar(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'PURCHASE, SALE, INWARD_ADJUSTMENT, OUTWARD_ADJUSTMENT, OPENING, RETURN',
  `reference` varchar(100) DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Invoice number, purchase order ID, or adjustment reason',
  `date` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'UTC transaction timestamp',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `idx_stock_movements_product_id` (`productId`),
  KEY `idx_stock_movements_date` (`date`),
  KEY `idx_stock_movements_prod_date` (`productId`,`date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin AUTO_INCREMENT=30001

targets.createTable:
